Amount of time to execute and return the data

available.description: List of coin networks which are supported in this xchain-explorer instance

last_block.description: Most recent block index processed by the indexer, keyed by coin ticker (e.g. RBTC: 850). Value is null for a coin whose per-coin DB read failed (the outage this health endpoint exists to surface).

last_block_time.description: Unix block_time of the most recent block processed by the indexer, keyed by coin ticker. Compare against the chain tip to detect indexer lag. Value is null for a coin whose per-coin DB read failed.

decoder_tip.description: Decoder's highest processed block index, keyed by coin ticker. null when the decoder tip is unavailable.

decoder_lag_blocks.description: decoder_tip minus last_block (how far the indexer trails the decoder), keyed by coin ticker. null when the decoder tip is unavailable.

chain_tip.description: Coin node's chain tip as the decoder reports it, keyed by coin ticker. null when the decoder health call is unavailable.

chain_lag_blocks.description: Decoder's self-reported gap to the chain tip, keyed by coin ticker. null when the decoder health call is unavailable.

decoder_health.description: Decoder self-reported status per coin ticker: 'healthy', 'unhealthy', 'unconfigured' (no decoder URL set), or 'unreachable' (health call failed).

supported.description: List of coin networks which are supported on the XChain platform
